title: Jacob resumes his address
summary: Jacob speaks again to his beloved brethren concerning the righteous branch and describes promises, future losses among their children because of unbelief, God's mercy, and their children's restoration to knowledge of their Redeemer.

explicit_facts.text: Jacob speaks again to his beloved brethren concerning the righteous branch of which he has spoken.
Jacob says the promises they have obtained are promises unto them according to the flesh.
Jacob says it has been shown unto him that many of their children shall perish in the flesh because of unbelief.
Jacob says God will be merciful unto many and their children shall be restored so they may come to that which will give them true knowledge of their Redeemer.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jacob may be shown addressing a group of listeners.
unspecified_visual_details: Jacob's appearance, clothing, posture, and age are unspecified.
The listeners' appearance, number, and identity beyond beloved brethren are unspecified.
The location, time of day, and arrangement of the gathering are unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: And now I, Jacob, speak unto you again, my beloved brethren, concerning this righteous branch of which I have spoken.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jacob

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The losses and restoration are future events described in Jacob's address, not events occurring before the listeners.
The righteous branch is part of Jacob's teaching, not a narrated visible supernatural event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not identify Jacob's parentage or assign the listeners a named people or settlement identity.

Do not invent a flashback showing how these things were shown to Jacob.
Do not depict God or the Redeemer visibly appearing.
